'''''Specter of the Past''''' is the first book in ''[[Star Wars: The Hand of Thrawn Duology]]'' by [[Timothy Zahn]]. It was first published by [[Bantam Spectra]] in [[November]] [[1997]]. Narration for the abridged audio version was performed by [[Anthony Heald]]. Narration for the unabridged audio version was performed by [[Marc Thompson]].
